method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 267, compilation date 27 August 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 79, 2026; register id C2026C00400, 12 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A05138.txt; rates from the Income Tax Rates Act 1986, Compilation No. 66, compilation date 1 July 2026 (amendments up to Act No. 50, 2026; register id C2026C00300), as deposited at ../../../income-tax-rates-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03348.txt; for the 2023-24 income year only (REQ-0056, 2026-10-22), rates from Rates Act Compilation No. 62, compilation date 1 April 2024 (amendments up to Act No. 3, 2024; register id C2024C00132), as deposited at ../../../income-tax-rates-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03348.2024-04-01.txt; the s 960-275 formulas the text deposit lost are transcribed from Volume 10 of the Word rendering of C2026C00400 in ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A05138.formulas.md (2026-10-22, REQ-0057); the other formulas the text deposit lost (ss 40-70, 40-72, 40-75, 61-155(2), 83-170(3), 115-115, 118-185, 294-40, 296-40, 296-45, 303-4(1), 328-190(1), 328-360, 960-275(1A), 960-285(5)) from the same sidecar's entries recovered 2026-10-24

checks.command: l4 run <file> for every module and case file in the folder (nine of each)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual taxpayer, for the 24 events of the WA cradle-to-grave lives that cite the Act: ss 4-10, 4-15 (taxable income, the income tax owed); Income Tax Rates Act 1986 s 3 ($18,200 tax-free threshold), Schedule 7 Part I (resident rates 2024-25 onward, and 2023-24 from Compilation No. 62), ss 23(2), 23AA (company rate); s 6-5; s 8-1; s 30-15 items 1-2 and (2), s 26-55 (gifts of money); ss 36-10, 36-15(2), 36-17(2) (tax losses); ss 61-110, 61-115 (Low Income tax offset); ss 61-155, 61-160 (working Australians tax offset, application year asked as a fact); ss 83A-25, 83A-30, 83A-33, 83A-35, 83A-45 (ESS upfront taxing and the start-up concession); s 355-100(1), (2) (small company R&D offset); ss 360-15, 360-20, 360-25 (early stage investor offset); ss 104-10(4), 110-36(1A), 114-10 (capital gain with indexation from 1 July 2027); itaa-cgt-indexation.l4: ss 110-25, 114-1(1), 114-25, 114-30, 960-270, 960-275(1B), (1C), (4), (5), 960-280(1) (the indexation factor worked out from CPI index numbers, which are inputs, and each cost base amount indexed from its own quarter, the third element excluded); ss 115-10 to 115-25, 115-100, 115-102 (discount); s 102-5 (one gain); ss 118-110, 118-150 (main residence); ss 152-10(1)(c), (1AA), 152-15 ($6,000,000 test); ss 128-10, 104-215, 118-60 (death); ss 290-230, 290-235; ss 291-20(2), 292-85(2); s 292-102; ss 294-30, 294-35; ss 301-10 to 301-40; ss 302-60, 302-140, 302-145, 302-195. Indexed caps, CPI index numbers, cost base amounts and aggregated turnover are inputs (itaa-cgt.l4's own capital gain question still takes a supplied factor). Left out: the rest of the Act (12 volumes), including Subdiv 112-E, Div 114 beyond ss 114-1(1), 114-10, 114-25, 114-30 (the cost base modifications of ss 114-15, 114-20), Subdivs 152-B to 152-E, Subdiv 83A-C, Subdiv 30-DB, Div 355 beyond the rate, Subdiv 360-B, the bring-forward rule, Medicare levy and HELP (other Acts). Formula modules of 2026-10-24: itaa-income-formulas.l4 (s 61-155(2) net labour income; ss 328-355 to 328-360 small business income tax offset and the tax owed with it; s 83-170(3) genuine redundancy, indexed under ss 960-270, 960-275(1A)); itaa-super-formulas.l4 (s 960-285 indexation of the concessional cap, the general transfer balance cap and the Division 296 thresholds; s 292-85(2) from them; s 294-40; s 303-4(1); ss 296-15 to 296-45); itaa-cgt-formulas.l4 (s 118-185; s 115-115(2), (3)); itaa-business-formulas.l4 (ss 40-70, 40-72, 40-75; s 328-190(1)). AWOTE and CPI index numbers stay inputs.
seat: the taxpayer: an individual Australian resident (in Daniel's life also the founder, shareholder and investor, who asks the company questions about his company)
